intro: Radiance is more than just shelving—it’s where strength meets style. Built tough to serve as open library racks in offices anf open referenceing areas, it offers the durability you need with a modern, streamlined design that fits beautifully into any space.

features.title: Robust Construction
features.text: Tie rod–reinforced structure at the back ensures stability and long-lasting durability.

features.title: Open Shelving Design
features.text: Provides easy visibility and access, making it ideal for referencing materials quickly.

features.title: Space-Smart Solution
features.text: Compact proportions make it perfect for small to medium office setups without compromising functionality.

features.title: Balanced Form
features.text: Thoughtfully designed to combine strength and elegance, maintaining a clean, airy appearance.

features.title: Versatile Utility
features.text: Serves as both a reference station and a stylish organizational element, enhancing efficiency in collaborative or individual work zones.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
